title: Magnetars can have starquakes that release huge bursts of gamma rays.
narration: Magnetars are neutron stars with ultra-strong magnetic fields. They can undergo starquakes, which are violent crust fractures. These events release powerful gamma-ray bursts. This scene describes that activity.
